coordinate_inputs.proof: 0x41D390 unpacks lParam: X = LOWORD(lParam) stored to [main+0x35B2A8], Y = HIWORD(lParam) stored to [main+0x35B2AC]; those same values are pushed as the two args of 0x42C510 at 0x41D457 (lea ecx,[esi+0x2A548C]; push Y; push X; call 0x42C510). 0x42C510 keeps them as ebx(X)/edi(Y) and re-pushes at 0x42C741 (push edi; push ebx; mov ecx, esi; call 0x42B430). 0x42B430 then calls 0x423FA0(win, X, Y, flag=0), which computes left' = X - [win+0x48], top' = Y - [win+0x4C] and right'/bottom' by adding [win+0x40]/[win+0x44] (width/height), then SetRect(0x4762B0).

coordinate_semantics.abs_vs_delta: ABSOLUTE 1:1 mouse-follow (client-area screen coords). The window keeps its grab point fixed under the cursor.
coordinate_semantics.grab_offset: 0x4240C0(win, X, Y) at drag start stores [win+0x48] = X - [win+0x18] (mouse minus window left) and [win+0x4C] = Y - [win+0x1C] (mouse minus window top); requires [win+0x30]/[win+0x34]/[win+0x3C] all nonzero.
coordinate_semantics.window_size: [win+0x40] = width, [win+0x44] = height. Both branches of 0x423FA0 add them to left/top to form right/bottom (primary-static).
coordinate_semantics.drag_equation: SetRect(&win+0x18, X-[win+0x48], Y-[win+0x4C], X-[win+0x48]+[win+0x40], Y-[win+0x4C]+[win+0x44]). Bottom clamp: if top'+height > 0x23A (570) then top' = 0x235 (565) - height, i.e. a 30px bottom margin on the 600px client (0x423FA0 @0x423F0A-0x423F29).
coordinate_semantics.second_setrect: A second SetRect(&win+0, left'-(origW-w)/2, top'-(origH-h)/2, right', bottom') centers the outer rect; origW/origH are read from the rect at win+8 (original size, identical when widths/heights match).
coordinate_semantics.setrect_target: SetRect imported at 0x4762B0; PtInRect imported at 0x4762B4.
coordinate_semantics.position_lifecycle: win+0x18 RECT is both the hit-test target (0x42AAB0 copies it per window id) and the position/size written by drag-follow; win+0 is the outer/original rect used for centering.
